# Trademarks

Kinetic is open source under the Apache License 2.0. The license covers the
code; it does not grant rights to the names and logos. "Kinetic", the Kinetic
logo, "Velocity" and the Velocity logo are trademarks of Velocity
(veloresearch.com). This policy says how you may use them.

## Use freely

- Say what your project is or does: "runs on Kinetic", "a Kinetic plugin",
  "benchmarked against Kinetic", "compatible with the Kinetic server API".
- Write about Kinetic: articles, talks, videos, courses and reviews, including
  critical ones.
- Redistribute official, unmodified Kinetic releases under the name Kinetic.
- Show the unmodified logo next to such a reference, or on a page that links
  to the project.

## Ask first

- Using "Kinetic" in the name of your product, company, domain, model or
  package, for example `kinetic-pro` or "Kinetic Cloud".
- Merchandise, sponsorship material, or anything that could suggest Velocity
  makes, endorses or supports your product.

## Not allowed

- Calling a modified version "Kinetic". A fork or a changed build needs its
  own name; you may say it is "based on Kinetic".
- Suggesting that Velocity certifies, verifies or tunes models or builds it
  did not. In particular, do not describe a `.ktc` file as verified by Kinetic
  unless `kinetic verify` passes on it, and do not imply a signature by
  Velocity that the file does not carry.
- Names or logos that are confusingly similar to Kinetic's.

## The logo

The logo files are in [`assets/`](assets). Use the lockup for dark
backgrounds on dark surfaces and the one for light backgrounds on light ones.

- Do not stretch, recolour, rotate, crop or add effects.
- Keep clear space around the logo of at least a quarter of its width.
- Do not combine it with other marks into a new lockup.

## Questions

Ask through [veloresearch.com](https://veloresearch.com) before you rely on a
use this page does not cover. This policy may change as the project grows;
the version in the repository is the current one.
